seriesAnalysis.opponentPatterns: All five opponents had CLEAR as 72-90% of reported commands (Le Masia 37/41, Amber Arcs 2 36/50, Agents United 30/39, Apocalypse 19/24, BlackEagle 33/37). Treat as labels in five small match samples, not a confirmed shared strategy or clearance success rate. Four reports with shot stats show each opponent had zero shots on target; Agents United stats were absent.
seriesAnalysis.tacticalReview: No goals conceded across five games. In the four reports with shooting stats, six shots on target correspond to six team goals; this is a small sample and not causal evidence. Two matches had very high MOVE shares: Agents United 555/600 in a 0-0 draw and Apocalypse 340/345 in a 1-0 win; BlackEagle was 319/370 in a 2-0 win. This does not support an automatic MOVE reduction. The 0-0 report shows only 2 SHOOT and 28 PASS alongside 555 MOVE, making shot quality/transition timing a useful follow-up question after the series, not an immediate mid-series edit.
seriesAnalysis.latencyReview: The target of <=10ms was not met. Four coherent own report team means span 84-786ms, versus opponent means 16-17ms; one anomalous Amber report is excluded. These are match-summary averages, not full-response p95 or cold-start evidence. L02 remained uninstalled after failing first-call gates on V1 and V2; no Fitness or candidate games were run.
seriesAnalysis.decision: Keep the registered baseline pending a separately gated candidate and exact event-level evidence. Do not tune from generated AI Coach Corner text alone.
